name: Marietta the Gathering 2026

venue.name: Glover Park
venue.details: East Park Square (3x3 Round 1 and 2 - Southeast Cubing Booth, 3x3 Round 3 - Stage)

information: This competition is a part of [Marietta the Gathering](https://www.mariettaga.gov/1480/Marietta-the-Gathering), a free outdoor festival celebrating pop culture, nerd/geek community, and the arts. All elements of the competition will be outdoors and subject to delay/cancellation in the case of inclement weather. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MariettatheGathering2026#66271-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)
